Simple overlapping layers

Source: R/polymer-package.R
ABC.Rd

A, B and C are three partially overlapping polygon layers with different attributes: A is four squares in a 2 by 2 grid over the unit square, B is a single triangle and C a single thin rectangle.

Format

'sf' data frames with no coordinate reference system:

  • A: 4 rows, layer, a and geometry.

  • B: 1 row, b and geometry.

  • C: 1 row, c and geometry.

Examples

polymer(A, B, C)
#> polymer mesh:
#> Layers:    3
#> Features:  6
#> Triangles: 42
#> Vertices:  26 (10 at crossings)
#> Overlaps:  15 triangles covered more than once, at most 3 deep
